MAKE THE SWITCH WITH CONFIDENCE

Bring your hardest booking to the trial.

01

Choose Apntly when you need unlimited bookings for a single service without a monthly app charge. Test the free plan with your actual service duration and assigned staff member.

02

For a growing appointment-only team, compare Apntly Pro at $9 with the Cowlendar tier matching your booking revenue. The subscription difference is clear; the decision is whether each app handles your full workflow.

03

For a business mixing date-range rentals, bundles and appointments, ask Apntly to demonstrate those requirements. Cowlendar explicitly lists multi-day and bundle bookings; missing documentation is not proof that a competitor cannot do them.

Your questions, answered.

Does Cowlendar have a free plan?

Yes. Cowlendar has a free plan with all features. Usage allowances apply; the pricing page shows the limits and revenue-based paid tiers.

Is Cowlendar cheaper than Apntly?

It depends on the features and booking revenue. Use the calculator above: it compares the lowest documented plan for your selected features and shows the assumptions, rather than comparing unrelated starting prices.

Does Cowlendar support subscriptions, an API and webhooks?

Yes. Recurring service subscriptions and bundles are supported. The public API and webhooks are documented as beta, including subscription-credit bookings and eight webhook events. Review the linked API limitations before planning an integration.

When should I choose Apntly instead?

A solo service or a team prioritizing a low fixed subscription cost. Group appointments, custom questions, calendar integrations and deposits are listed on Pro. Check the exact workflow before choosing Starter.
